spans.s:
चैतन्य, i. e. चेतन + य, n.
 1. Intellect. Yājñ. 3, 81.
 2. Consciousness, [] Vedāntas. in
चैत्त, i. e. चित्त + अ, adj. Belonging to the dominion of thought, Vedāntas. in

चैत्य,
 I. probably चिति + य, m. The individual soul, Bhāg.

.
 II. चिता + य, m. and n.
 1. A tomb,
. A sacred tree; a religious fig-tree growing in a village, or near it, and held in veneration by the villagers,

चैत्र, i. e. चित्र and चित्रा + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Made of a tree called citra,

.
 II. m. The name of a month, March--April,

.
 III. f. त्री, The day of the full-moon in this month,

चैत्ररथ, i. e. चित्र-रथ + अ,
 I. adj. Treating of the Gandharva Citraratha,

.
 II. patron. m. and f. थी, A descendant of Citraratha,

.
 III. n. The name of a forest,
+ पाल चैत्य- + पाल, m. the watchman of a sanctuary.
+ वृक्ष चैत्य- + वृक्ष, m. a fig-tree growing in a holy place,
